Who we are

One Brand.
Three Experiences.
More Ways to Discover.

Life isn’t limited to one kind of discovery. Neither are we. GoGlobalMart brings product discovery, direct online shopping, and food exploration together within one brand.

Each experience has its own purpose. Affiliate Shopping connects you with external retailers. Mini Store is our own e-commerce business. Food Restro is our food and restaurant business. Together, they create more ways to explore — without blurring how each one works.

Different journeys. One GoGlobalMart.

How it works

Three journeys.
No blurred lines.

One shared brand does not mean one shared checkout. Here’s what makes each experience different.

Read our affiliate disclosure
01Discover here. Purchase with the retailer.

Affiliate Shopping helps you discover products. Follow an affiliate link to the external retailer, where you complete your purchase. That retailer handles checkout, payment, shipping, returns, and order support under its own policies. GoGlobalMart may earn a commission from qualifying purchases.

02Explore our own Mini Store.

Mini Store is intended for orders placed directly through GoGlobalMart’s own e-commerce experience, separate from affiliate retailers. Listings and cart controls are visible, but a completed checkout, payment or fulfilment flow has not been verified. Check the store’s available options and policies before placing an order.

03 Discover food through Food Restro.

Food Restro is a separate food and restaurant experience with categories, restaurant listings and menu links. Its intended food-ordering journey is distinct from retail shopping. Current ordering availability, payment options and delivery coverage need confirmation within that experience.
